attributes.body:
AArete names healthcare executive Pam Shipley as chief executive officer.

Global consulting firm's founder Loren Trimble to step down after 18 years of growth and recognized excellence

CHICAGO-(BUSINESS WIRE)-AArete, a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete Founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member.

Shipley joins AArete from Centene Corporation, a leading managed care organization, in which she most recently served as chief strategy officer. She spent nearly 14 years at Centene over two tenures where she held multiple CEO roles in Georgia, Missouri and Mississippi and led digital transformation and market expansion across more than 15 markets.

Over her three-decade career in healthcare, Shipley has built a reputation as an executive who combines deep operational expertise with technology-enabled innovation, including senior leadership roles at Kaiser Permanente and Sharecare spanning healthcare technology, provider operations and consulting-driven transformation. Recognized for her ability to align strategy, technology and operations to drive growth, Shipley brings to AArete a track record of helping organizations navigate complex transformations in highly regulated, technology-driven environments.

"As a former client, I have worked closely with AArete throughout my career and witnessed firsthand the firm's ability to accelerate growth and drive results," Shipley said. "My work has always been personal to me. I've focused on making healthcare more affordable and effective for the people and communities served by health plans. AArete's talented team and proven solutions are uniquely positioned to help clients do exactly that. I'm honored to build on Loren's legacy and excited to continue delivering value for our clients."

AArete drives profitability improvement, digital transformation and AI solutions for clients across a range of industries, including the healthcare payer segment, which has become the firm's signature strength. The firm advises on U.S. health plans of every type, including Medicaid, Medicare, ACA Marketplace and commercial, helping clients manage the total cost of care and expand affordability without sacrificing quality or the member experience. In 2025, AArete secured a strategic investment from Parthenon Capital, a growth-oriented private equity firm with deep experience backing healthcare solutions and technology companies, further strengthening the firm's continued growth.

"What we've built at AArete would not be possible without a culture built on integrity, excellence and care for the people we serve, and I'm proud that Pam will continue that legacy," Trimble said. "She's a purpose-driven leader whose passion for people and delivering results for clients reflects the values of the firm. I am confident she will lead AArete into its next chapter and build on its success."

Trimble established AArete in 2008 with the goal of building a consulting firm that nurtures long-term client partnerships. Under his leadership, AArete grew into a global firm with more than 500 team members, earning recognition as a Forbes World's Best Management Consulting Firm for four consecutive years and a USA Today Top Workplaces Award, underscoring the firm's strong culture and people-first approach.

"AArete has become an essential partner to many of the nation's leading health plans, and Pam is exactly the right leader to build on the firm's momentum going forward," said Dan Killeen, partner at Parthenon Capital. "Her payer expertise and track record of driving growth and performance make her uniquely suited to lead AArete into the future. We are grateful to Loren for his visionary leadership and look forward to his continued engagement as a member of the board."

AArete signals next phase of growth with key leadership appointments.

New leaders strengthen strategy, corporate development and clinical intelligence capabilities to deliver additional value for clients

CHICAGO-(BUSINESS WIRE)-AArete, a leading global tech-forward consulting firm, today announced the appointments of Jeff Berger as vice president, strategy and corporate development, and Dr. Danielle Smith as vice president, clinical intelligence. These strategic additions reflect AArete's continued investment in leadership, innovation and specialized expertise as the firm advances its next phase of growth.

"Jeff and Danielle will be great additions to the leadership of our growing firm," said Loren Trimble, chief executive officer of AArete.

"They are accomplished leaders with proven track records of driving transformation, accelerating growth and delivering results. Their appointments reinforce our commitment to serving clients at the highest level with healthcare innovation as we position the firm for continued success."

Jeff and Danielle's appointments reinforce our commitment to serving clients at the highest level with healthcare innovation as we position the firm for continued success.

Loren Trimble, CEO

Advancing firm strategy and growth.

As vice president, strategy and corporate development, Berger serves as a strategic partner to AArete's executive leadership team, helping define firm-wide priorities and translate strategy into action. He leads the firm's corporate development initiatives, including merger and acquisition strategy, due diligence and post-merger integration.

Berger brings more than 20 years of experience in strategy, corporate development and operational excellence. Prior to joining AArete, he spent two decades at Protiviti, where he partnered with executive leadership to advance enterprise strategy, organizational effectiveness and growth initiatives.

Berger holds a master's degree in business administration from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business and a bachelor's degree in accounting from the Indiana University Kelley School of Business. He is a certified public accountant (CPA) and a Six Sigma Green Belt certified by the American Society for Quality.

Expanding clinical intelligence capabilities.

As vice president, clinical intelligence, Smith helps expand AArete's clinical intelligence capabilities across several strategic solution areas. Her expertise spans clinical operations, medical management, utilization management, clinical policy and government-sponsored healthcare programs.

With more than 20 years of experience in healthcare and managed care, Smith has deep expertise in advancing healthcare quality, patient safety, clinical efficiency and value-based outcomes. Throughout her career, Smith has served as a transformational leader focused on quality improvement, operational excellence and healthcare innovation. Her previous leadership roles include vice president at Redwood Management Inc., national medical director for clinical policy at Molina Healthcare and program medical director/chief hospitalist at Sound Physicians.

Smith earned a master's degree in business administration from the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater, a medical degree from the Medical College of Wisconsin and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse. She also holds a Lean Six Sigma certification and Six Sigma Black Belt from Villanova University.

"We are fortunate to have Danielle and Jeff join our team. These leadership appointments represent another important milestone in AArete's growth journey," added Trimble. "As organizations face increasing complexity and pressure to transform, we are investing in the talent and capabilities required to help them navigate change, unlock value and achieve results."

AArete adds vice presidents Jeff Berger and Danielle Smith.

22 July 2026 Consulting.us

AArete, a Chicago-headquartered management consulting firm, has hired Jeff Berger as vice president for strategy and corporate development and Danielle Smith, MD as vice president for clinical intelligence.

In his new role, Berger will lead the firm's corporate development initiatives, including M&A strategy, due diligence, and post-merger integration.

He brings more than 20 years of experience in strategy, corporate development, and operational excellence. Berger joins from consulting firm Protiviti, where he spent the last two decades and most recently served as director for account management and client experience. Before that, he was director and chief of staff for global industry and strategic account management.

Berger has an MBA from the University of Chicago and a bachelor's degree in accounting from Indiana University.

In her new role, Smith will help expand AArete's clinical intelligence capabilities across several solution areas.

She has more than 20 years of experience in healthcare and managed care, with expertise spanning clinical operations, medical management, utilization management, clinical policy, and government-sponsored healthcare programs.

Smith was previously vice president at Redwood Management Inc., national medical director for clinical policy at Molina Healthcare, and program medical director/chief hospitalist at Sound Physicians.

She has an MD from the Medical College of Wisconsin, an MBA from the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater, and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse.

"Jeff and Danielle will be great additions to the leadership of our growing firm," said Loren Trimble, chief executive officer of AArete. "Their appointments reinforce our commitment to serving clients at the highest level with healthcare innovation as we position the firm for continued success."

attributes.body:
AArete expands executive team with Jeff Berger and Dr. Danielle Smith.

July 20, 2026

Jeff Berger and Dr. Danielle Smith

AArete has strengthened its executive leadership team with the appointments of Jeff Berger as vice president of strategy and corporate development and Dr. Danielle Smith as vice president of clinical intelligence, expanding capabilities as the consulting firm accelerates growth and deepens its healthcare advisory services.

The additions support AArete's strategy of investing in leadership and specialized expertise to meet growing demand for consulting services focused on healthcare transformation, digital innovation and operational performance.

"Jeff and Danielle will be great additions to the leadership of our growing firm," said Loren Trimble, chief executive officer of AArete. He said both executives bring proven records of driving organizational transformation and will help the firm expand its healthcare innovation capabilities while supporting its long-term growth strategy.

In his new role, Berger will work closely with AArete's executive leadership team to help define enterprise priorities and execute strategic initiatives. He will also lead the firm's corporate development activities, including merger and acquisition strategy, due diligence and post-acquisition integration.

Berger joins AArete with more than 20 years of experience in corporate strategy, business development and operational improvement. He previously spent two decades at Protiviti, where he partnered with senior executives on enterprise strategy, organizational effectiveness and growth initiatives.

His background includes expertise in corporate finance and process improvement. Berger holds an MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, a bachelor's degree in accounting from Indiana University's Kelley School of Business, and is both a certified public accountant and Six Sigma Green Belt.

Smith will lead the expansion of AArete's clinical intelligence capabilities, supporting consulting engagements across healthcare operations, medical management, utilization management, clinical policy and government-sponsored healthcare programs.

She brings more than 20 years of healthcare leadership experience spanning clinical operations, quality improvement and managed care. Throughout her career, Smith has focused on advancing patient safety, improving clinical efficiency and supporting value-based care initiatives.

Before joining AArete, she served as vice president at Redwood Management Inc., national medical director for clinical policy at Molina Healthcare, and program medical director and chief hospitalist at Sound Physicians.

Smith earned an MBA from the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater, a medical degree from the Medical College of Wisconsin and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse. She also holds Lean Six Sigma certification and a Six Sigma Black Belt credential from Villanova University.

Trimble said the appointments represent another step in the firm's broader expansion strategy as clients seek guidance on increasingly complex operational and technology challenges.

"We are fortunate to have Danielle and Jeff join our team," he said. "As organizations face increasing complexity and pressure to transform, we are investing in the talent and capabilities required to help them navigate change, unlock value and achieve results."

AArete is a global consulting firm that advises organizations on profitability improvement, digital transformation, strategy and organizational change. The firm combines data analytics, market intelligence and technology-driven solutions to help clients improve operational performance, accelerate transformation initiatives and support long-term business growth.

AArete strengthens healthcare, operations and AI consulting leadership with managing director promotions.

Addition of VP of Legal & Compliance Positions Consulting Firm for Sustained Growth

CHICAGO, Feb. 24, 2026 - AArete, a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the promotions of Diane Body, Emily Dawes, Konrad Siczek and Priya Iragavarapu to managing director, as well as the strategic addition of Scott Zambo as vice president of legal and compliance. These leadership appointments position AArete for continued growth and excellence in client delivery on a global scale

AArete has promoted four managing directors, from left: Diane Body, Emily Dawes, Konrad Siczek and Priya Iragavarapu.

Diane Body, managing director: Diane is an accomplished consulting leader with over 30 years of IT and operations leadership spanning the commercial software, provider and health insurance markets. Her expertise focuses on assessing business needs, defining product requirements, leading application development and implementations and managing quality assurance for AArete's healthcare payer client base.

Emily Dawes, managing director: Emily is a trusted healthcare leader specializing in total cost of care strategy. She partners with health plans to translate complex data and market intelligence into actionable initiatives that drive measurable cost savings and operational improvements. As a leader in AArete's Network Solutions practice, she helps clients design and operationalize high-performing provider networks. She leads data-driven engagements that move beyond strategy into execution, aligning contracting, policy and network design to improve affordability, enhance quality and strengthen competitive market positioning.

Konrad Siczek, managing director: Konrad is an established consulting leader with over a decade of experience advising healthcare payer and provider clients on profitability improvement and operational transformation. He has led transformational network initiatives for both national and regional payers, advancing affordability and quality of care through advanced analytics, market intelligence and organizational change strategies. He serves as co-lead for the firm's Network Solutions vertical, driving solution development, firmwide training and business development to support client growth and innovation.

Priya Iragavarapu, managing director: Priya is a distinguished consulting leader in data, analytics and artificial intelligence with over two decades of experience and a proven track record of driving transformative change at scale. She partners with C-suite executives to align AI adoption with strategy, ensuring solutions are technologically advanced, practical and impactful. As a recognized leader in applied AI, she leads the firm's AI solutions and is one of the co-leaders behind AArete's innovative and patented Doczy.ai(TM) solution with numerous downstream applications across payment accuracy, claims operations and provider network intelligence.

"Diane, Emily, Konrad and Priya have consistently delivered with exceptional results for our clients," said AArete CEO Loren Trimble. "These promotions recognize each of their significant achievements and underscore our commitment to elevating internal talent and client delivery excellence. We remain dedicated to fostering a culture of continuous growth and professional development at AArete."

Scott Zambo, vice president, legal & compliance: Scott brings more than two decades of legal experience, spanning corporate law, healthcare law, compliance and regulatory issues. Prior to joining AArete, he served as a trusted advisor to the firm as counsel at Kelley, Kelley & Kelley. In his new role, Scott will provide strategic guidance on all legal matters and oversee contracting processes, compliance program development and legal risk management.

"Scott brings deep knowledge of our business and a long history as a trusted advisor to our firm," Trimble said. "His appointment strengthens AArete's legal, compliance and risk management capabilities as we help clients navigate an increasingly complex regulatory environment."

In addition, AArete announced the promotions of three team members to vice president focused on serving clients with excellence:

* Jeremiah Nace, vice president, focuses on advancing healthcare data analytics and scalable cloud data platforms for health plans.
* Brian Poulter, vice president, bridges the business and technical expertise needed to build health plan member-centric strategies and drive digital transformation.
* Adam Schulz, vice president, brings payer operations, strategic profitability improvement and Payment Intelligence(R) expertise to clients.

Demonstrating its ongoing commitment to excellence and industry leadership, AArete was recently named one of Modern Healthcare's Largest Management Consulting Firms of 2025. The firm also earned placement on both Forbes America's Best Management Consulting Firms 2025, recognized in the Healthcare & Life Sciences category, and Forbes World's Best Management Consulting Firms, where AArete has been globally recognized for four consecutive years. In addition, AArete was honored with a USA Today Top Workplaces Award, underscoring its strong culture and people-first approach.

About aarete.

AArete is a global management and technology consulting firm specializing in driving profitability improvement, digital transformation, and strategy & change for clients. AArete's solutions are powered by a digital-first mindset, market intelligence and data-driven approach to deliver purposeful change, actionable insights and guaranteed results. AArete humanizes data by translating numbers into actionable insights, helping clients make better decisions and standing by their side to foster change with confidence, empathy and purpose. For more information, visit aarete.com.

Health IT appointments & hires.

Anonymous Health Appoints Industry Leader Bob Poznanovich to Spearhead Inaugural Advisory Council
Anonymous Health, the most comprehensive AI suite for behavioral health, announced the appointment of Bob Poznanovich as Chairman of its newly formed Advisory Council. Launched at a pivotal moment in the AI revolution, the Advisory Council will unite the industry's foremost thought leaders to shape the future of behavioral health: driving innovation across clinical care, admissions, operations, and long-term outcomes.

Highmark Health Appoints Karen Hanlon President
Highmark Health announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Karen Hanlon president of Highmark Health effective immediately. Hanlon will also retain her current title of chief operating officer and will continue to report to David Holmberg, who will remain in his current roles of Highmark Health chief executive officer and board chairman of Highmark Inc.

Health & Wellness Partners Appoints Nick Price as Chief Operating Officer, Bringing Global Agency Leadership from Klick
Health & Wellness Partners, LLC, a medical communications and strategic engagement company, is pleased to announce the appointment of Nick Price as Chief Operating Officer. Nick joins HWP from Klick, where he served as Executive Vice President, Global Operations, playing a pivotal role in scaling one of the industry's most dynamic agency platforms.

Strive Health Welcomes Michele Paige as Chief Growth Officer
Strive Health, the national leader in value-based kidney care, has appointed Michele Paige as its Chief Growth Officer. Paige is tasked with driving sustainable, strategic growth for Strive Health and providing cross-functional leadership across the company's sales, customer success, patient experience, product and marketing teams.

Coriolis Pharma Accelerates U.S. Expansion with Strategic Appointments in North Carolina
Coriolis Pharma announced the next step in its U.S. expansion by strengthening its team in North Carolina with the appointment of John Gabrielson as President of Coriolis Pharma US Inc. and Amber Raines as Senior Director, Client Project Management.

Apex Health Names Peter J. Kelly as President
Apex Health, a tech-enabled management services organization that enhances the enterprise value of health systems, announced the appointment of Peter J. Kelly, MBA, as President. In this new role, Kelly will oversee financial performance, operations, and growth of the company, reporting to Scott Huebner, Apex Founder and CEO.

TigerConnect Appoints Two Senior Executives to Advance Clinical Innovation and Business Expansion
TigerConnect, a provider of unified communication solutions for healthcare systems, is excited to announce the appointments of Dr. Peter Stetson as Chief Medical Information Officer and Sheeza Hussain as Chief Growth Officer. These additions to TigerConnect's leadership team come on the heels of its acquisition of eVideon and several key product launches - and are the latest milestone in the company's commitment to industry-leading innovation to unify healthcare communications.

PayZen Appoints Sanjeev Kapur as Chief Operating Officer to Accelerate Product Innovation in New Era of Healthcare Access
PayZen, an AI-driven patient affordability platform, announced the appointment of Sanjeev Kapur as its new Chief Operating Officer. In this role, Kapur will grow and scale PayZen's product, research and development, operations, and marketing functions to meet the rising demand for comprehensive solutions that address the healthcare affordability crisis.

AArete Expands Healthcare Consulting Practice with 2 Managing Directors
AArete, a global management and technology consulting firm, announced the addition of two managing directors, Pam Price and Gina Hedstrom. Price's and Hedstrom's appointments further position the firm's healthcare consulting practice for continued growth and excellence.

eMed Population Health Appoints Dr. Dyan Hes as Chief Medical Officer
eMed Population Health, Inc. announced the appointment of Dr. Dyan Hes as Chief Medical Officer. A board-certified pediatrician and Diplomate of the American Board of Obesity Medicine, Dr. Hes will provide executive medical leadership, with a focus on improving outcomes in preemptive care management.

Hires, promotions, & accolades.

AHCA/NCAL Names New Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Liz Burns
Ghe American Health Care Association/National Center for Assisted Living (AHCA/NCAL), representing more than 15,000 nursing homes and other long term care facilities that provide care to approximately five million people each year, announced that Dr. Elizabeth (Liz) Burns, MD, has been named the association's chief medical officer, effective October 18, 2025. Dr. Burns has more than 25 years of experience as a physician and clinical innovator, advising policymakers and providers on modernizing and integrating the healthcare system as well as public health emergency response strategies.

Harris Data Integrity Solutions' Mackenzie Higgins Receives AHIMA's Emerging Star Award
Harris Data Integrity Solutions, a provider of best-in-class patient data integrity services and software, announced that its strategic growth manager, Mackenzie Higgins, RHIA, has received AHIMA's Emerging Star Award. The association recognized Higgins for her commitment to the health information (HI) profession, career accomplishments, and excellence in team collaboration, as well as her professionalism, problem-solving, and innovation.

Interwell Health Welcomes CEO Tommy O'Connor to Accelerate Value-Based Kidney Care
Interwell Health, the nation's leader in value-based kidney care, welcomed Tommy O'Connor as its Chief Executive Officer. O'Connor brings extensive healthcare leadership experience to guide Interwell's mission of transforming kidney care through innovative value-based solutions that improve patient outcomes while reducing costs.

P-n-T Data Corp. Announces Full Board of Directors and Executive Leadership Team
P-n-T Data Corp., a provider of managed services for healthcare data sharing, formally announced its full Board of Directors and executive leadership team. Together, these individuals bring deep domain expertise in healthcare, cybersecurity, finance, enterprise systems, and artificial intelligence - critical pillars supporting the company's Post-n-Track Gen 3 platform and mission to de-risk healthcare data sharing and residency. See the complete list.

Sellers Dorsey Welcomes New Associate Director, Sasha Rasco
Sellers Dorsey is excited to announce that Sasha Rasco, former Texas Chief Prevention and Community Well-Being Office and Texas Associate Commissioner for Family Support Services, is joining the firm as Associate Director for Child and Family Well-Being.

AssureCare Welcomes Susan Reagan as Vice President of Sales
AssureCare(R) LLC, a healthcare company that provides integrated population health management software uniting payers, providers, and pharmacies on a single connected-care platform, announced that Susan Reagan has joined as Vice President of Sales. In this role, Susan will lead sales strategy and business development initiatives to accelerate growth and strengthen partnerships across health systems, payers, and healthcare organizations.
